- [L45](../hardware/devices/digitone.md#L45) [untagged] Stock MAIN then writes CACR `0xa50ce100` at `0x4000055a`, after its copies. That write invalidates the instruction, branch and data caches and turns caching on. The same CACR value appears on the Rytm and A4 MKII. `digitone#e3994520`
